tei:div.tei:p: pa/ slob dpon ston pa/ bsod dbang*/ lo mchog dbang lo/ bsod grags/ grags rgyal/ rin rgyal ba/ rgyal ba phyag na/ chos kyi rje kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ dbon ston skyer pa sgang pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ 'jag chen shes rab tshul khrims/ 'jags chen rgyal mtshan 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zla ba blo gros/ mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ dbus pa zi ston/ gnam kho'u pa/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ shes rab dpal/ glo bo shes rab rin chen/ chos rgyal ba/ rong pa sher seng*/ kun dga' tshul khrims/ bag ston/ tshul rgyal ba/ bsod rin pa/ chos grags pa/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ sgrol ma ljang khu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ snur ye rgyal/ snur chos 'phags/ gar thig pa sangs rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ phag gru mthil gyi chos sgo ba/ phag gru mthil gyi mkhan po/

grags rdor ba/ bla ma byang chub rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros rin chen dpal bzang po// des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mi g.yo ba/ grub thob 'od byed 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ 'dul 'dzin byang chub tshul khrims/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ rgyal mtshan gzhon nu grags/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shes bya kun gzigs/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ seng lding nags kyi sgrol ma/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ bi ka lam ka rdo rje gdan pa/ cal chos bzang pa/ dngos grub dpal/ bla ma chos grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka la sems dpa' chen po zla ba blo gros pas gsan/ de la mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros pas gsan/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ gang blo ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs dhi ra pa la/ rngog lo khyung rin chen grags/ stod lung rgya dmar/ cha ba/ gtsang nag pa/ dan 'bag ba/ smyal zhig bzang rings/ gra thang pa/ bsod rgyal ba/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston/ mkhan chen yon rgyal ba/ bla ma a mo gha/ slob dpon kun dga' dpal/ de gnyis la 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal bas gsan/ chos rje kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/

mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ mi g.yo ba/ byang sems kun dga'/ ston ye/ byams chen pa bsod 'phel ba/ bag ston gzhon tshul ba/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ phag gru'i mkhan po grags rdor ba/ byang chub rdo rje/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ dzaṃ bha la nag po rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rngog ston/ smyal pa/ gtsang dkar/ mar ston/ gtum ston/ tsang jo mo/ shākya 'bum/ shākya gzhon nu/ blo ston jo mgon/ de gsum ka la blo ldan pas gsan/ de la bla ma dbang rdor bas/ de la rin chen rgyal mtshan bas/ de la rgyal ba phyag nas/ de la mkhan po rin po che kun dga' blo gros pas gsan pa yin/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ dzaṃ bha la ser po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ slob dpon rin po che/ btsun pa dkon mchog skyabs/ lce mdo sde seng ge/ de phyin ni gong gi dzaṃ bha la nag po'i rgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ sangs rgyas sman bla'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ shan+ta rak+ṣi ta/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ sad na legs/ ral pa can/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'od srung*/ dpal 'khor btsan/ nyi ma mgon/ ye shes 'od/ bkra shis sde/ 'od sde/ rtse sde/ mnga' ris pa/ khu ldan pa/ ra sa pa/ dpal ldan gro/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ sgrags snying po rgyal mtshan/ kun smon/ gangs pa/ bsod grags pa/ bsod bzungs pa/ grags rgyal ba/ rnam rgyal ba/ rgyal po phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o//

༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang gi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ zangs dkar zhus skyas/ grags seng*/ rgya ston/ rgya ston grub mchog rdo rje dpal gzhon nu/ seng ge bsod rgyal ba/ bu ston/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma chos grags pa/ bsod rin pa/ chos rje rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po'i zhabs/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ dpal rdo rje gdan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gtso 'khor gsum pa ba ri lo tsās bsgyur ba/ 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ slob dpon sba kan+dhas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa tshig lhug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+yi bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ a ra pa tsa na sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ yang a ra pa tsa na dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor lnga pa ba ri lo tsās bsgyur ba/ yang 'jam dpal zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog dmar mo/ 'jam dpal rdo rje gtso 'khor lnga pa dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal yi ge drug pa dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor lnga pa/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'khor gcig pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rgyal po 'jam dpal rol pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong dharma kīrtis bsgyur ba/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa nyung ngu paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba ba ris bsgyur ba/

shes rab skye bar byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sbyor ba ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa 'am/ yang na zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang 'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dmar zhing dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zla ba'i mdog can/ yang 'jam rdor dpa' bo gcig pa dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i 'jam dpal dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ gshin rje mthar byed nag po zhal drug zhabs drug pa'am/ kha cig zhal drug phyag drug pa/ ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ mthar byed sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje chos dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa pū dza na bha dras mdzad pa/ rje btsun seng ge sgra dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sngon po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ yang mthar byed nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ bcom ldan 'das ha la ha la sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa tshigs su bcad pa lhan cig skyes pa rol pas mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ kha sar+pa ṇi sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs nyung ngu slob dpon rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge drug pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor gsum du sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa ser po zhal drug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/

paṇ+ḍi ta a mo ga badz+ra dang*/ ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das ha la ha la dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yan lag thams cad dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor bcu pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i spyan ras gzigs sku mdog nag po zhal lnga phyag bcu gnyis pa slob dpon dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ljang khu bla ma rdo rjes myu gus mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rjes dang khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu rgyal pos mdzad pa/ yang seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gc-ig phyag gnyis ma ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i slob dpon mthu bos mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ u rgyan gyi 'od zer can sku mdog dmar po zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis pa a mo gha badz+ra dang khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong dharma kīrtis bsgyur ba/ rtogs pa las byung ba'i 'od zer can ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba dge slong dharma kīrtis bsgyur ba/ rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo zhal lnga phyag bcu zhabs bzhi pa dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/

lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ u rgyan gyi 'od zer dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ dge slob ba ris bsgyur ba/ u rgyan gyi rim pa'i 'od zer can dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ lha mo tsun dha dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ u tsus sa ma ta dzaṃ bha la sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ 'phags ma khro gnyer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang dge slong ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rgyal ba byams pa zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang khams pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ nor sbyin ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ shes phyin ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mdor bsdus pa/ m-i g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dze tā ris mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba'i las mtha' slob dpon pra bha kīrtis mdzad pa/ gtum po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ba ri lo tsā'i 'gyur/ lo ma gyon ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ 'od zer can dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad/ pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang khams pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/

'phags ma 'od zer can gyi gzungs rdo rje gdan pa dang ba ri'i 'gyur/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma slob dpon pad 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ dpal bgegs kyi dgra sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ral pa gcig ma nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ 'phags ma dug sel ma zhal drug ma de'i gzungs rig byed ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gzhi ma/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i rigs byed ma/ dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yang rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i rig byed ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ u rgyan las byung ba'i rig byed ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sa ra has mdzad pa/ dpal snod gnas ser po yum can gtso 'khor dgu pa/ rgya nag po'i rim pa'i sgrol ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma gser mdog can zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma gtso 'khor bcu gcig gshin rje gshed mthar byed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum can/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ 'phags ma rma bya chen mo ljang khu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ 'phags ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo nag mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sku mdog nag po zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma/ 'phags ma rnam par rgyal ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rdo rje gan+dha ri nyid sku mdog nag mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma/ gur mgon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog sgrol ma sngon mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/

bcom ldan 'das stobs po che dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ dpal rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dpal he ru ka yab yum zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bdag med ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ yang bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rtogs pa las rgyud pa'i 'od zer can ser mo zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad ma/ rdo rje phag mo dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'phags ma rig byed ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ ha la ha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ 'phags pa gnod pa gnas chu dbang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rnam rgyal gtso 'khor dgu pa/ 'od zer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ bskul byed ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rnams paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i rig byed ma dkar mo/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bsdus pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs rnams la chos tshan brgya tham pa yod pa thob pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng*/ mchims brtson 'grus bla ma/ rtsi mchims 'dul 'dzin/ ngor rje chos rdor/ rong pa rga lo/ gce blo ldan/ bla ma dge slong*/ gce dbang rdor/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //lung dang rjes gnang gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/

dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun snying*/ slob dpon bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ snur yer rgyal/ snur chos 'phags/ gar thig pa sing rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ phag gru mthil gyi chos sgo ba/ phag gru mthil gyi mkhan po grags rdor/ bla ma byang chub rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ tsan+d+ra kīrti/ rig pa'i khu byug a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan mnga' ba/ rnal 'byor pa/ bya yul ba/ dge bshes klu men pa/ des snar thang pa nas brgyud de/ mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ dwags po lha rje/ zhang sum thog pa/ bka' stsal pa/ bla ma lha ba/ rin po bzang po/ mkhan chen bde ba/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bsod rgyal ba/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje kun blo ba/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang snying po don gsum brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ til+li pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mi tra dz+wa ki/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ 'dzam bu ba bsod dbang*/ khro phu rin po che/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa/ bsod grags pa/ grags rgyal ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal ba/ rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/

mgon po tshe dpag med/ spyan ras gzigs/ grub chen ra hu la/ dpal ldan a ti sha/ gung thang pa/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ des rong lag sor ba/ bag yul ba/ des 'phags gce sgo dang*/ mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis la gnang*/ de gnyis ka la sangs rgyas skyer sgang pas gsan/ des sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ des 'gro mgon chos rje ston pa/ des mkhas grub shangs ston/ des mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ des khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ des bya bral ba ri khrod rin chen/ des 'jam dbyangs shangs pa dkar po/ des mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang po/ des chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ des rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ des chos rje kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// 'di ni rim pa ltar zhal mthong ba bar ma chad pa'i brgyud pa'o// yang dran ston gyi bden bdar gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma shākya dpal/ mkhan chen rgyal mchog pa/ rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i chos tshan thob pa'i rim pa ni/ klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i gzungs/ rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ mgon dkar dur khrod bdag po'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i brgyud le'u brgyad pa/ dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs/ zhal gdams sa chen kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ mgon dkar dur khrod bdag po'i rgya gzhung*/ 'dzing pa lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs dang las sbyor/ dur khrod bdag po'i las tshogs yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ dur khrod bdag po'i mchod gtor/ rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/

dur khrod bdag po'i bstod pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang*/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes u tsār+ya la brten nas slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho dang*/ sgrub thabs bgegs 'joms rdo rje zhes bya ba dge slong byang seng gis mdzad pa/ de'i las tshogs/ bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/ gzungs sgrub bstod pa dang bcas pa 'phags pas mdzad pa/ khrus chog rgyas pa dang*/ rims drag po gcod pa'i tshul dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa/ khro bo rme rtsegs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ de'i bstod pa/ gtor chog dang bcas pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje dril bu phreng ba gsum gyi rjes gnang rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i las tshogs chos drug tu grags pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma bzhi'i cho ga jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ sha ba ri sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rgya gzhung*/ pad+ma drag po'i sgrub thabs/ mkhan chen don grub dpal 'byor bas mdzad pa/ pad+ma drag po'i dbang chog gter kha gong 'og gnyis ka mthun pa/ mi 'khrug pa'i rgyud 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i gzungs/ mtshan brjod bklag pa'i man ngag kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can gyi sgrub thabs/ lo rgyus las tshogs dang bcas pa/ bdag gis ni chos rje rin po che rgyal ba phyag na la yang zhus shing dpon sa gong ma rin po che la thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen de nyid kyis khong rang gi bla ma ma hā bho dhi bya ba la zhus 'dug rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ phyag na rdo rje gtum chung dang bcas pa 'khor rta bdag brgyad/

klu brgyad/ sde brgyad dang bcas pa/ mgon po gsang sgrub ljang khu yab yum/ mgon po gar mkhan mchog ljang khu zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa gtso 'khor brgyad/ drag byed nag po klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mdung dmar can gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i gtso 'khor nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ nang ma mo ltar bsgrub pa gtso 'khor dgu rnams kyi sgrub thabs gtor chog bskang bshags/ bstod pa/ bskul/ gtor rdzongs dang bcas pa'i lung dang*/ rjes gnang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī yi bde mchog dkar po'i chos bskor rnams la/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa yum phag mo dmar mo dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i man ngag gnyis/ bram ze chen po sa ra has mdzad pa/ paṇa chen mtshur phu ba la gnang ba'i zab chos su grags pa bde mchog dkar po'i rdzogs rim dmigs pa zab mo paṇa chen nyid kyis mdzad pa de nyid 'grel pa mkhan chen lho brag pa byang chub dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes rim lnga'i dbang chog bdag nyid kyis yi dam lha dbang len pa'i gdams pa/ cog ro chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ 'di dag gi rgyab chos kyi dbang byin rlabs lung tshang ma dang bcas pa/ nā ro pa'i chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ mar pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad ma/ shog dril bzhi/ grub chen sha ba ri'i do ha/ nag po pa'i do ha/ til+li pa'i do ha/ bir+wa pa'i do ha/ khyad par rje btsun bir+wa pa'i do ha'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ sgra mkhan pa/ pu ra pa/ bai ro tsa na badz+ra/ zhang g.yu brag pa/ sgom pa tshong ston/ gce sgom rdzong ba shes rab 'bar/ 'dul ba rdo rje/ sprul sku dkon mchog bzang po/ rtogs ldan rgya ston pa/ 'dzing pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ ār+ya de wa/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chos grags dpal/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen dpal/ 'khrul zhig grags pa bkra shis pa/ 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rgyal mtshan/

mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po des bdag la'o// ༈ //do ha gzhan rnams kyang bla ma bai ro man chad 'di dang mthun/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ shog dril bzhi rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje mar pa/ tshur dbang nge*/ 'jang bu rgya gar ba/ stod lung gar ra/ bla ma nyi ma lung pa/ rog bde gshegs/ rtse ba sgang pa/ mnyam med thams cad mkhyen pa/ g.yu ston rdo rje dpal/ bla ma bsod nams bzang po/ khu ston tshul mgon/ thod ston rgyal mtshan grub/ bla ma rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chos grags dpal/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang jo bo'i lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa dang*/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dpa' bo rdo rje thum chog dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ gser gling pa/ a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ rgya yi sgom/ grub thob nub 'bar/ zhang dge slong kun ye/ bla ma khus ston/ 'phags 'o/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ sems dpa' chen po zla ba blo gros/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba tshul khrims shes rab/ khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ge/ tshad ma'i skyes bu tshul khrims mgon po/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon po/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ des bdag la'o// yang rin po che de'i drung du/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ man ngag brgya rtsa dang 'dra'o// yang mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ sur+ya sing ha/ dharma badz+ra/ mu tri sidhi/ de pa shwa/ smi ti/ chang sde ngag dbang*/ khams pa shes rab rdo rje/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog lba ba/ rong sman lha steng*/ jo 'bum/ co mdo sde seng*/ rong pa rga lo/ 'jam dbyangs lho pa grub seng*/ ston pa chos bzang po/ thun pa mgon/ bsod grags pa/ grags rgyal ba/ rin rgyal ba/ rgyal ba phyag na/ des mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang kā ri ka lnga bcu pa'i lung*/ so so thar pa'i 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum cho ga phyag len dang*/ so thar mdo sogs rgyas par thob pa'o// ༈ //mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid brtse ba'i mnga' bdag las// mdzad pa'i gzhir gyur ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dpal// nus pa mthar phyin smra ba'i dbang phyug gtso// bstan pa'i nyi ma gang de rgyal gyur cig ces slob dpon rin po che bka' bcu smra ba blo gros bstan pa'i zhal mnga' nas kyi drung du/ dam pa'i chos thob pa la/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i lung*/ spyod 'jug gi lung*/ shes spring gi lung*/ blo sbyong rgyas pa/ chos nyid rnam 'byed/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ sman bla skor gsum/ mtshan brjod/ cha gsum 'bring po/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ ne gu rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ shes spring sa bcad/ chos spyod rab gsal/ so thar/ mdo rtsa ba/ seng gdong can gyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya 'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bshad pa/ gzhi gsum cho ga sogs ma lus rgyas par thob pa'o// legs pa'i dpal ldan rin chen mchog gi rgyan// bzang po'i phrin las gdul bya'i gling la mdzes// 'dul 'dzin gnyis pa gang de rgyal gyur cig /ces pas/ gsang ste ston pa slob dpon rin po che legs rin pa'i drung du chos thob pa la/

las kyi cho ga cha lag tshang ma'i lung*/ tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang lung dang bcas pa/ thos pa rgya mtsho/ gang gi mchod rdzas dang mchod 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa sogs kyi lung rnams legs par thob par byas so// bkra shis lung gi dpal yon can// grags pas sa steng khyab pa po// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad pa'i// bshes gnyen gang de spyi bos mchod// ces pas/ bla ma bkra shis rgya mtsho'i drung du chos thob pa la/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor dbang*/ dpal mgon phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang rgyas pa/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang rnams legs par thob pa'o// man ngag rgya mtsho'i mthar son cing*// rin chen dbang gi rgyud lung rgyas// mchog gi rtogs pa bskyed mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams bzhi spyi bos mchod// ces/ man ngag mtshon pa thob pa'i bla ma sngags rnying ma pa'i ngo bo sna tshogs rang grol gyi bu chen drung du/ u rgyan rin po ches mdzad pa'i las tshogs kun 'dus kyi mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i za yig rdzas sbyor dang bcas pa'i lung nos/ bla ma mnga' ris pa'i drung du/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i rdzogs rim/ lam zab mu dra'i man ngag grib bsrung rgyas bsdus/ tshe khrid/ chu 'thung ma sogs man ngag mang ba thob// ༈ //bla ma khams pa'i drung du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i yang bsrung bzlog rbad gsum gyi za yig rten 'brel ma sogs man ngag thor bu thob pa'o// ༈ //yang bla ma rat+na bhu tra'i drung du/ byang sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub las tshogs kha tshar dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa'o// ༈ //zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhur blangs rtsa rlung gnyis la rang dbang thob// tshe gcig sgrub pa brnyes pas sku gsung thugs kyi gsang sgo bye// phrin las tsha zer rgyas pas 'gro blo'i mun sel ba// stong dang snying rje dbyer med rdo rje 'chang dbang de nyid rgyal gyur cig

/ces pas/ grub chen rin po che blo gros dpal ldan pa'i drung du chos thob pa la/ 'ba' ra bas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas tshe dpag med kyi dbang*/ tshe khrid kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rje mi la chen po/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ rje phag mo gru/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ spyan snga rin po che/ yang dgon pa/ thugs sras spyan mnga' rin ldan/ chos rje zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba chen po/ bla ma rin chen dpal ba/ bla ma chos grags dpal ba/ byang sems zla ba blo gros/ grub chen tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ grub chen dpal ldan pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang grub chen rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ skal ldan thar lam gyi yig cha'i steng nas/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gzhung gi brgyud pa/ thabs kyi brgyud pa/ shes rab kyi brgyud pa gsum las/ dang po ni thub dbang*/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ ār+ya de wa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ skyo ston rnam gnyis/ ma cig lab sgron/ rtsi ston dar ma/ glang lung pa/ gnyal pa/ mal gro ba/ grub pa 'bar/ spang po pa/ shākya bla ma/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ rin chen gzhon nu/ sgro ston chen po/ rin chen 'od zer/ chos kyi dbang phyug zhen med ras pa/ gzhon nu bzang po/ ye shes 'od zer/ shes rab seng ge blo gsal ri khrod pa/ 'khrul zhig tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ grub chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o// thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ ār+ya de wa/ dam pa/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma/ ma cig khu sgom chos seng*/ dol pa zang thal/ rgya nag gcer bu/ sangs rgyas rab ston/ sangs rgyas don blong*/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ chos rje gser gling pa/ rdo rje dpal/ chos dpal shes rab/ blo gsal ri khrod pa/ 'khrul zhig tshangs pa/

grub chen pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //shes rab kyi brgyud pa ni/ yum chen mo/ sgrol ma su kha sid+dhi/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab sgron/ rgyal ba don grub/ dam pa dbus pa/ rdo rje bdag gzhon nu ye shes/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ sangs rgyas bstan pa/ 'gro mgon lung phran pa/ gdan gcig pa bsam gtan dar/ mi nyag rin rgyal ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pa/ bla ma rin po che/ grub chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang bla ma de'i drung du/ u rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung chung dang*/ zla ba seng ge'i khrid yig rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ u rgyan pa/ zla ba seng ge/ se ras pa/ bla ma tshul grags pa/ bla ma rtogs ldan rin chen pa/ grub chen pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na zla ba seng ge yan 'dra la/ des chos rje byang rtse ba/ 'jam dbyangs chos mgon pa/ bla ma tshul grags pa/ drung tshangs pa ba/ grub chen pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang grub chen de nyid kyi drung du/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bsrung ba sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa dang*/ 'phags pas mdzad pa/ rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa tshar gsum khug pa rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom pa/ chos rje nyab chen pa/ brag phug pa/ mkhas btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bu ston pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ chos rje nyi ma ba dang*/ bsam 'grub dpal bzang po gnyis ka'i drung nas gsan/ yang na paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ mkhas btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bu ston/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ bla ma bsam 'grub dpal bzang drung nas kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung sgros/ shes rab bla ma'i zhu yig dang*/ de'i lan nye gnas sang rin la gdams/ nye gnas nam mkha' byang chub la gdams pa/ yul mdo khams su skyes pa'i dad pa can la gdams pa/ gegs sel nyams kyi yig chung*/

yang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid lung*/ rlung bum pa can rgyan chen dang rgyan chung*/ de'i rgyab chos la sha ba ri'i rgya gzhung bshad pa/ gegs sel man ngag lus sbyongs nā ro drug skor/ ras chung drug skor/ bsre 'pho drug skor/ sum cu so bdun ma/ ras chen pas mdzad pa'i gangs seng ma/ gzhung cha lag dang bcas pa/ lus sbyongs bcu gnyis ma/ gtum mo nyi shu pa/ yan lag lnga sbyongs/ bsnyen sgrub kyi 'khrul 'khor cha lag rdzogs pa/ mtshan brjod bklag pa'i man ngag mtshan brjod kyi lung*/ grib gzugs brtag pa/ srog gzugs brtag pa/ gzhan gyi srog gzugs brtag pa/ dri chu bar ma'i bsrung ba sgrub lugs brtag pa/ yang rje ras chung pa'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub/ phyi snang ba mtha' yas ltar gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa/ nang tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku la brten te tshe'i sgo bsdam pa sku'i rdzogs rim/ gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba las/ brda sgyur rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ brda sgyur rdo rje'i bzlas pa la 'jug pa oṃ dang gnas pa āḥldang ba hūṃ du shes par bya/ zhes pa las/ dang por oṃ sgrub par bya ste/ dang po yi ge dang por bzhag /dbyangs yig lnga pas yang dag brgyan// sde tshan lnga pas mtha' car can// zhes pas so// āḥsgrub pa la/ sgra mtshams sbyor lnga pa ltar/ mtshungs pa dang 'dra ba'i yi ge las ring por 'gyur te/ pha rol 'ang dbyi'o zhes pa dbyangs yig dang po gnyis la brten te sgrub/ hūm̐ sgrub pa la/ ya ra la sogs yi ge dgu// klad skor nga ru klag par bya// zhes pa dang*/ ha dang po la klad skor rgyag cing zhabs kyu btags/ ra dang sa dag gis rnam par bcad bya'o// zhes pa ltar rnams rgyab nas 'jog pas so// de ltar bzlas pa sogs/ don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni yid bzlas so// 'gog pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni rlung 'gog pa ste/ yon po sgyur ba bum pa can rab 'bring tha gsum gyis bsgrub pa/

rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// de nyid kyis gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ thugs kyi ngo bo sgrub pa'i rdzogs rim phra thig gnyis las/ dang po thig le'i rnal 'byor/ snying khar tshe yi phur pa gdab pa ste/ hūm̐ gi sa bon bskyed pa'i zhabs kyu las/ lcags sgrog 'phros te/ srin lag bar du bsrings la/ sa bon gyi yi ge nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi tshul du gnas pa'i bar du bcug ste/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor dmigs rten de nyid la brten te nang du bsam pa brtan par byed pa'o// de rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ rje phag mo gru pa/ rin po che mtshan dpal bzang po/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ yang dgon pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa bkra shis dpal/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal/ grub chen rin chen dpal/ bla ma chos kyi dpal ba/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ des bka' drin mnyam med grub chen/ rin po che blo gros dpal ldan pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang bla ma de nyid kyi drung du/ mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma nas brgyud pa ni gu chos drug gi lung tshang ma/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs ma sogs thob/ shangs pa bka' brgyud nas rgyud pa'i dpal mgon phyag drug pa'i dbang lung*/ mgon po sku lnga'i rjes gnang khrid lung dang bcas pa thob// ༈ //yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs kyi mgon// mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa// thogs med smra ba'i dbang phyug spyan snga ba// mang thos yon tan mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// bslab gsum dri med sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa'i dpal// byang chub sems kyi bum pa rab rgyas pa// gsang sngags 'bras bu'i bcud phyung 'phur lding can// sku gsum rkang drug ldan pa khyod phyag 'tshal// rig pa'i gnas rnams ma lus mngon du gyur// mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gdul bya'i gling la phog

/snyan pa'i ba dan grags pa'i dpal yon can// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab 'dzin pa khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pas rgyal ba ma lus pa'i glog phreng gcig tu bsdus nas dad pa'i sa gzhi brlan par mdzad te/ skal ldan mtha' dag gi lus sems kyi dri ma sbyangs nas/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i lam la sbyor bar mdzad pa/ chos kyi rje chos kyi rgyal po chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na gsung rab mang thos pa'i zhal mnga' nas kyi drung du chos thob pa la/ thog mar rang byung gi ye shes rtogs par byed pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog tshe gcig lus gcig la mchog gi 'bras bu ster bar byed pa'i nye lam du gyur pa/ mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang khrid/ zhal gdams dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro ye shes dngos grub/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ rje mi la/ mnyam med dwags po/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal ba gcung*/ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams/ chos rje rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje rgyal po/ chos kyi rgyal po/ don grub rgyal po/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ mang thos gsung rab pa dkon mchog rin chen dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di rnams khrid du gsang ba'i mtshan 'di rnams gsang mtshan gyi bzlas pa byed de/ srog 'khor gyi bsnyen pa sngags su byed pa 'di yin no/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dhṛka sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru pradz+nyā bha dra sid+dhipha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru dz+nyā na sid+dha sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru dharma ma ti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/

oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dh+wa dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru puṇ+ye rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra ra dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru rat+na shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru puṇ+ye kīrti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru rat+na sing ha sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru kīrti pūṇ+ye sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra ra dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru dharma ra dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru ā mo gha ra dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra ga ga dh+wa dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru wa ki shwa ra dh+wa dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru wa ki shwa ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru tra ya rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ru ā nan+da dharma dh+wa dza shrī bha dra sid+dh-i pha la hūm̐/ ༈ yang rin po che de'i drung du/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor nyams khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ de phyir spyi dang 'dra yang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ til+li phyin 'dra/ yang na ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ sha ba ri/ rgyal ba mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ mar pa/ de phyin spyi dang 'dra/ ring brgyud ni/ lho phyogs nas sgyu lus bar do'i bka' bab/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ zla ba grags pa/ ma taṃ gi/ byang phyogs nas bya spyod rmi lam gyi bka' bab ni/ lu hi pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ su ka dha ri/ shar phyogs gtum mo'i bka' bab ni/ skal ba bzang mo/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ par+ṇa ri pa/ nub phyogs nas 'od gsal gyi bka' bab ni/ ḍoṃ bhi pa/ bi na pa/ lwa ba pa/ in+d+ra bhu ti rnams so// de nas mar pa/

mi la/ dwags po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rat+na bha dra/ mthong ba don ldan/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ ma pham chos rje/ rab 'byams smra ba gsung rab mang thos dkon mchog rat+na/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang na/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ rin chen mgon po/ shes rab bla ma/ bkra shis bla ma/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ kun spangs chen po/ bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ byang chub rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang ngag gi dbang po/ gsung rab rin po che/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ gling ras pa/ rgya ras/ rgod tshang pa/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ shes rab 'bum/ rin chen gzhon nu/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bkra shis blo gros/ rab 'byams gsung rab mang thos pa/ des bdag la'o// yang rin po che'i de'i drung du/ rngog lugs kyi dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ rngog ston chos kyi rdo rje/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ rngog kun dga'/ gzi brjid grags pa/ rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi grags pa/ rngog don grub dpal/ rngog sangs rgyas yon tan/ rngog ston byang chub dpal/ rngog rin chen dpal/ rngog byang chub dpal grub/ rab 'byams gsung rab mang po thos pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rngog byang chub dpal yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ rab 'byams smra ba gsung rab mang thos pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ mos gus srog gi 'khor lo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la ras pa/ sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje rdo rje grags pa/ rin chen seng ge/ grags pa bsod nams/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rat+na ra dza/ dharma rā dza/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ gsung rab rin po che/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang phag mo lhan skyes kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mthong ba don ldan yan phyag chen rgya gzhung gi brgyud pa phyi ma dang 'dra'o// de nas dpal 'byor don grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa/ gsung rab rin po che/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che'i de'i drung du/ gu ru drag po'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ mnga' bdag myang*/ nam mkha' 'od zer/ nam mkha' dpal/ sprul sku rdzong pa sku mched/ dā+e ba bhā dra/ dharma ra dza/ sum ldan yab sras/ 'jam dbyangs mgon/ dga' rab rdo rje/ mkhas grub dpal ldan 'od/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje pad+ma rgyal po/ gsung rab rin po che/ des bdag la'o// yang gong gi/ phag mo lhan skyes kyi dbang gi brgyud lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje don grub rgyal po/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ gsung rab mang thos pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang na rje sgam po pa yan gong dang 'dra la/ des karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/

ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung ba/ g.yung ston pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rat+na bha dra/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ gsung rab rin po che tra yā bha dra/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ bram chen po sa ra ha'i do ha thob pa la/ rgyal po do ha/ btsun mo dau ha/ dmangs do ha/ bshad pa zin bris dang bcas pa/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad/ zin thun/ rdzogs rim gyi rnam bshad/ kyai rdo rje'i cho ga shis brjod dang bcas pa thob// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ gu ru drag po'i dbang chog gi lung*/ byad bzlog gi srung 'khor sgom bzlas kyi dmigs pa sogs rgyas par thob par byas so// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ slob dpon pad+mas rjes gzung zhing*// yang dag don la nges shes skyes// mkhas dang grub pa brnyes pa yis// zla ba'i mtshan can la phyag 'tshal// gsang sngags gsar rnying ma lus thugs la 'khrungs// tshe gcig mchog gi sgrub pa lhur len cing*/ rim gnyis brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba// yongs rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal// zab gsal gnyis med bde ba'i gar bsgyur zhing*// lhun grub 'bras bu'i dpal la longs spyod nas// 'gro ba'i re skong sprul pa'i skur ston pa// rgyal ba sku bzhi'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gzi 'od kyi// bdag sogs gdul bya'i pad tshal rab rgyas pa// chags dang thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis// smin grol dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa bskyed du gsol// zhes bstod pa dang smon lam btab nas// bla ma rin po che sbas pa'i brtul zhugs brnyes pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos pa gsang sngags 'dzin pa zla 'od kyi zhal mnga' nas kyi drung du chos thob pa la u rgyan gyi rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i gcod rnying ma'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

chos sku kun tu bzang po/ yum chen longs spyod rdzogs sku/ sprul sku bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ 'phags pa rjes 'dzin kun dga'o// 'phags mchog klu sgrub mgon po/ 'chi med rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ chos rgyal khri srong sprul pa'i sku/ yum chen shes rab mtsho rgyal/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ de sras pad+ma dbang chen/ gu ru sangs rgyas rdo rje/ grub thob dpal ldan rdo rje'i zhabs/ ga ga rat+na'i zhabs/ de sras ga ga bshes gnyen dang*/ chos kyi rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ de gnyis char gyis bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //gcod rnying ma tshang ma'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku yum chen mo/ sprul sku shākya thub pa/ 'phags pa rjes 'dzin kun dga' bo/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ 'chi med rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ shes rab yum chen mtsho rgyal/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ pad+ma dbang chen/ gu ru sangs rgyas rdo rje/ grub thob dpal ldan rdo rje/ drin can ga ga rat+na/ 'khrul zhig kun dga' bshes gnyen/ chos rje zla ba 'od/ des dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ā nan+da rat+na dpal bzang po la'o// yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ tshe khrid ras chung lugs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mnyam med sgam po pa/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum mgon/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ chos rje zur phug pa/ thugs sras chos rje spyan snga rin ldan/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ chos rje zla ba 'od/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag myang ral pa can/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ rnal 'byor ye shes rdo rje/ bla ma dad pa dpal bzang*/ bla ma mtshams pa/ chos rje zla ba 'od/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ myang ral pa can/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ mdo bo ras pa/ me long rdo rje/ mtshan ldan ha ri rdo rje/ snubs ston sangs rgyas/ des bla ma dad pa bzang po la'o// de phyin gong bzhin no// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i rgyud kyi lung thob pa'i rim pa ni/ chos skyong spyi'i rgyud/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ man ngag gi rgyud do/ dang po spyi rgyud la bzhi ste/ gri gug dang mthun pa gri gug brtsegs pa'i rgyud/ rta mang dang mthun pa mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud/ beng ma dang mthun pa beng chen rol pa'i rgyud/ mgon po thams cad dang mthun pa rin chen dpung rgyan gyi rgyud/ 'di'i spyi rgyud la gsum las/ skye rgyud gtso bor ston pa srin po thugs rje 'byung ba'i rgyud dang*/ dbang dang dam tshig gtso bor ston pa bya rog brtsegs pa spyi'i rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang las tshogs gtso bor ston pa bum pa bzang po spyi'i rgyud/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gsum ni/ spu gri klad gzer nag po yab kyi rtsa rgyud dang*/ drag po mtshon cha 'bar ba las mgon gyi rtsa rgyud dang*/ dug rlangs khol ma yum gyi rtsa rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud gsum ni/ khrag mtsho khol ma yab rgyud dang*/ srog gzan nag po las mgon gyi rgyud dang*/ lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka yum gyi bshad rgyud do// man ngag gi rgyud gsum ni/

las gsang ba man ngag sbas yab dang*/ gzhi snying sbas pa'i rgyud las mgon gyi dang*/ ma mo 'jig rten gtsug gi rgyud yum gyi man ngag gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud do// thun mong gi rgyud gsum ni/ mkha' 'gro ma snying rje khros pa'i rgyud dang*/ khros ma snying po bsdus pa'i rgyud dang*/ khros ma las tshogs phreng ba'i rgyud do// bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ dpal nag po chen po bya rog gdong can lung bstan pa thugs rje 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ dpal nag po'i rgyud chen po khrag mtsho khol ma zhes bya ba le'u brgyad cu gya gcig pa/ khrag mtsho khol ma nang gi rgyud chung ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rgyud/ dngos grub 'byung ba le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ dpal nag po chen po las gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i rgyud bya rog rtsegs pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'phags pa spu gri klad gzer nag po dngos grub 'byung ba'i bka' rgyud chen po le'u bcu bdun pa// ༈ //dpal nag po chen po bya rog gdong can gyi rgyud gsang ba chen po'i le'u bcu pa/ 'jig rten las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi srog gzan nag po nang gi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ 'jig rten las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi gzhi snying sbas pa srog gzer gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ las kyi mgon po thod pa nag po'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ dpal nag po chen po bya rog gdong can gsod byed srog gi spu gri'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ dpal shan pa nag po'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bcud 'dus kyi rgyud le'u drug pa/ gsod byed dmar po rtsa 'jib rkang 'dag ma'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mkha' 'gro ma la de phyi la zhus pa'o// slob dpon rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pas tshangs pa klu 'dul gyi lha khang nas gter nas phyung ba yin no// re ma ti'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/

gri gug brtsegs pa'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa rnams legs par thob pa'i rgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ lha lcam klu'i bu mo/ ra hu la bha dra/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ klu byang*/ dus 'khor ba che chung*/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ā bha yā ka ra/ rtswa mi/ rga lo/ rje phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ rje spyan mnga'/ rgyal ba/ bcu gnyis rnying ma ba/ 'o la ba/ brag pa rin rgyal ba/ rgyud bla ba/ mgon gzhon pa/ rdor ye ba/ gzhon she ba/ rat+na bha dra/ mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis/ rtogs ldan ngag dbang ba/ yang na paṇa pa/ lha gzig pa/ rat+na bha dra/ sprul sku shar smad pa/ yang brag pa rin chen rgyal ba/ tshes bzhi rnying ma ba/ bcu gnyis gsar ma ba/ tshes bzhi gsar ma ba/ kun spangs pa/ lha gzigs ras pa/ rat+na bha dra/ mkhan chen shar smad pa bsod nams bkra shis/ rtogs ldan ngag dbang*/ yang na bla ma zhang*/ rin chen gdan sa ba/ rtogs ldan gzhung pa/ rin po che rgyal sras ba/ chos dbyings pa/ dkon mchog rdo rje/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdor ye ba/ gzhon shes pa/ rat+na bha dra/ mkhan chen shar smad pa bsod nams bkra shis/ yang rdor ye ba/ paṇa pa/ 'jam dbyangs pa/ rat+na bha dra/ mkhan chen shar smad pa bsod nams bkra shis/ rtogs ldan sangs rdor ba/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa/ chos rje zla ba 'od/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la yongs su rdzogs par gnang ba yin no// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa dpal rga lo lha lnga'i dbang thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ mgon po klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma grags pa seng ge/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes/

bla ma dam rin chen/ bla ma tshul khrims dpal ba/ bla ma shākya seng ge/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa/ sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ de nas bdag gi rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la dgyes shing bstsal ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung*/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i las rim bstod 'bum/ bla ma yi dam gter mgon dang bcas pa'i bskang yig ha sgrog ma/ sde dpung rin chen spungs pa rgyas pa/ sde dpung chung ba bstan pa rin chen rgyas bskang*/ beng gi bskang yig a phyi'i bskang yig nor bu phreng ba che chung*/ tshe ring ma'i bskang yig dam can gyi bskang yig bzlog bskang rin chen spungs pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa yang*/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/ sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma grags pa seng ge/ bla ma dar ma rin chen/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes/ bla ma shākya seng ge/ bla ma tshul dpal ba/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa/ sprul sku bsod rgyam pa/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstsal ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ lha mo re ma ti lcags phur bdun ma'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub yig gi bzlas lung thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ spu rang pa dar ma rin chen/ la stod kyi khyung po stag sham can/ skyu ra rgyal ba ye shes/ phyag bla chen mgon po/ stong dpon shes mgon po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ rab chen pa/ stong dpon shes rab 'bar/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ rang byung rdo rje/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje/

rje chos grags rgya mtsho/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la thugs dgyes shing gnang ba'o// yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag can gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag can/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka slob dpon ar+ṇa/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ dmyal ba sur+ya dz+wa la/ dmyal ba jo sras/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ snyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ chos kyi rje rang byung rdo rje/ rtogs ldan rin chen singha kīrti/ mkhas grub dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos kyi bzang po/ chos dpal ye shes/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na ye shes kyi mgon po/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka slob dpon ar+ṇa/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ dmyal ba sur+ya dz+wa la/ dmyal ba jo sras/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ karma pa/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ bla ma mgon po rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ kun spangs kun dga' blo gros/ rat+na bha dra/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na ni rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ dmyal ba nyi ma 'bar/ dmyal ba jo sras/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas grags pa/ rgyal sras puṇ+ya badz+ra/ grub chen karma pak+ṣi/ gnyan ras saṅga lak+ṣa/ chos kyi rje rang byung rdo rje/ rtogs ldan kun dga' gzhon nu/ mkhas grub byams pa rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku yon tan bkra shis/ rgyas sras kun dga' 'od/

chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la thugs dgyes shing gnang ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ skyes bu dam can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan/ gu shrī dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ chos kyi rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston rin chen gling pa/ sprul sku nam mkha' 'od zer/ ri khrod pa nam mkha' legs pa/ bla ma chos dbyings pa/ rnal 'byor pa dpal bzang po/ slob dpon phun tshogs pa/ slob dpon rgyal ba rin chen/ slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar con paṇa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ ngo gro ba mkhas grub dbang phyug dpal ldan pa/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ dpal mgon po legs ldan gyi dbang*/ de'i phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ cho ga sogs kyi lung*/ yang rin po che de'i drung du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng gi rjes gnang sogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ klu sgrub snying po/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma grags pa seng ge/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes/ bla ma dar ma rin chen/ bla ma skyid shod pa tshul dpal/

bla ma shākya seng ge/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa/ sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i sgrub yig gi lung rjes gnang sogs thob pa'i brgyud rim ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ lha ras pa nas bla ma rnams spyi 'gros ltar la/ bla ma stag lung rin po che ngag dbang grags pa/ bla ma 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che'i de'i drung du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ klu sgrub snying po/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/ sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma grags pa seng ge/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes/ bla ma dar ma rin chen/ bla ma tshul khrims dpal ba/ bla ma shākya seng ge ston pa ngag dbang grags pa/ sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na ni/ dpal chen rga lo yan gong dang 'dra la/ rga los/ phag mo gru pa la/ des rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ skyi shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma bya tshul ba/ bla ma mgon gzhon pa/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon bo rgyal mchog bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga ā nan+da rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rin po che de'i drung du/

gu ru zhi ba rtsa gsum dril sgrub gu ru chos dbang gis brag gnam skas can nas bton pa/ mnga' bdag nyang gi sras mi bskyod rdo rje la gnang ba'i dbang lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ring brgyud kyi dbang du byas pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston gu ru chos dbang*/ des nyang gi sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ mdo bo ras pa sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dkon mchog bshes gnyen/ rtogs ldan kun gzhon pa/ byams pa rgyal yon tan bkra shis/ rgyal sras kun dga' 'od/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o/ ༈ /nye brgyud ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ mnyam med mdo bo ras pa/ grub thob me long rdo rje/ mtshan ldan ha ri rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ye shes rdo rje/ bla ma dad pa dpal/ bla ma rin po che mtshams chen pa/ chos rje zla ba 'od pa/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la thugs dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas gnang ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i dbang legs par thob par byas pa'i brgyud rim ni/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rgyal sras til+li pa/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa/ mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstsal ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/

phag mo lhan cig skyes ma thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po lha rje/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pa/ mkhas grub u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba g.yung*/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig pa'i ral gri/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ gu shrī dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal sras kun dga' 'od/ chos rje zla ba'i mtshan can/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o// ༈ //yang bla ma rin po che de'i drung du/ bde mchog nam mkha' mnyam rgyud chos skyong gi rgyud 'bum gyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i rgyud rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ā bha yā ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis bsgyur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong dang mtshungs so// yang rin po che de'i drung du/ gshin rje tshe bdag nag po yang bzlog me'i spu gri thob pa'i brgyud rim ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bsdu ba po dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gtsug lag dpal dge/ shan+tiṃ gar+bha/ dā na hū la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ ba su dha ra/ jo bo sangs rgyas/ khu lung yon tan rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ sto ston lcags pa/ mes ston dran chung*/ dran ston mtha' bral/ mes ston dkon rin/ slob ston bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon lha sgom/ bla ma gangs pa/ bla ma bya bral ba/ rgyal ba g.yung ston/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa/ mkhas grub byams pa rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku yon tan bkra shis/ rgyal sras kun dga' 'od/ des rtsa ba'i bla ma zla 'od pa la gnang*/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstsal

ba'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de'i drung du/ gu ru drag po mnga' bdag myang gi gter kha'i dbang lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ mdo bo ras pa/ gu ru sangs rgyas bkra shis/ bla ma dkon mchog bshes gnyen/ rtogs ldan kun dga' gzhon nu/ mkhas grub byams pa rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku yon tan bkra shis/ rgyal sras kun dga' 'od/ des chos rje zla ba'i mtshan/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o/ ༈ /yang bla ma de'i drung du/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i sngags bzlog zab khyad can gyi bzlas lung thob par byas so// de ltar gsan yig nor bu'i phreng ba 'di// bkod pa'i rnam dkar dge ba dri med des// sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// sgrub pa bsam gtan klog pa thos pa dang*// bsam sogs chos spyod bcu yis bsgrubs pa dag /nam mkha'i mtha' klas mnyam pa'i bsod nams de// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'phel gyur cig /gang zhig smon lam grub pa zhes// bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags tshogs byang sems rang rgyal che rnams dang*// dngos grub ster dang bar chad sel mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// ma lus lus pa med dang zhing khams kun snang rten sku ye shes mdzad pa phrin las 'bad rtsol bral ba lhun gyis grub pa rnams// bdag sogs lus can nam mkha'i mtha' klas bsod nams zhing dang smon lam grub pa'i rten dpang nyid du gsol 'debs na// yid bzhin re ba bskong phyir dang po'i thugs bskyed yongs rdzogs snyel ba mi mnga' 'gro don phyir// thabs stobs smon lam ye shes mdzad pa'i dgongs pa myur 'grub shog

/rang lus rten 'brel tshogs pa'i zhing las legs grub phra rab rdul gyi grangs mnyam mngon sprul te// zhing rnams til gyi gang bu lta bur bkang ste lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang gsum rang bzhin grub dang dngos bshams yid kyis rab sprul pa// mchod pa'i bye brag brjod bral yid 'das kun bzang rnam sprul mchog bkod gzhan don blo yis dbul bar bgyi// lus can rang bzhin sngon mtha'i sgrib pa ma 'ongs dus dang da lta'i byas bsags dag /mngon par bshags dang 'gyod dang phyin chad mi bya mi sems mi 'jug dag phyir bshags par bgyi'o// so so skye dang nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis gang bsags dang*// bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags dang yod dge bgyis dang bgyid rtsal bgyid la bdag yid rang*// bla na med pa'i dam pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bsams bzhin 'gro don rab 'jug mchog rnams la// chags bral rnam grol lam mchog ston phyir 'khor lo'i phreng ba thogs te bskul ma 'debs// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs dang dag par ma gyur bar dag tu// mya ngan mi 'da' bde chen chos sku rdo rje'i skur bzhugs 'gro ba'i re ba bskong mdzad gsol// rnam dag bdun ldan gsol ba btab pa'i dge tshogs gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba dri med des// sems can thams cad yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal mchog myur thob shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba'i len mtha' gang dag dang ni khyad par tshe 'dir ma lus skye ba thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yongs 'dzin bla na med pa rnams ni mnyes byed cing*// mos dang gus pa'i bsams pas dus mtha'i mos gus dang mi 'bral shog /skyabs tshe byin chags gnas skabs mthar thug mgon khyod mnyes byas nas// mi brjed rjes gzung sgrib bsal spang bslu chos can med 'jigs bcas las legs grol te// dam pa'i don du 'gro phyir sangs rgyas nyid kyis skyob ste nyid sku 'thob par shog

/dang por me tog phog ste sngon gyi gnas dang lhag pa'i lhar gyur pa'i// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor dag gis mnyes byas dus rnams kun tu mi 'bral shog /hūṃ phaṭ nga ros bdud dpung 'joms mdzad sngon sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i// dam bca' dran mdzad 'gro rnams dge la bskul dang de yi bgegs rnams bsal mdzad shog /bdag sogs tshe rabs kun tu dad thob bstan mjal mi mthun phyogs kyi mi gos dang*// mthun 'gyur rten dang brten pa'i lus ngag 'dul dang khrims ldan dge sbyong go'u ta mar 'grub 'gyur shog /bden gnyis rten 'brel mngon gyur don dam sems kyi rtsa ba bdag med nyid// rab tu rtogs nas sngags kyi yid 'chang zung 'jug bdun ldan tshe gcig mngon 'thob shog /nyes phung 'ching byed sdug bsngal theg byed mngon gyur nas// bden bzhi don grub 'khor lo dang po'i don rtogs shog /nye bar 'chi dang srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod byed lta ba'i dug sel ba// mtshan nyid med dang bden gnyis dag byed 'khor lo bar pa'i don rtogs rang sangs rgyas thob shog /mya ngan 'das la mi gnas yang dag mtha' dang stong nyid rten 'brel mngon gyur nas// theg gsum 'du shes rnams bral mkhyen dang brtse dang nus ldan mi zad yongs rdzogs 'khor lo tha ma'i don rtogs don gnyis ldan pa myur thob shog /byed pa gsum gyi rgyu yi theg par dam bcas tshogs gnyis shing rta'i srol 'byed pa// stong dang stong pa che dang lhag bsam yongs rdzogs mi zad gter gyis 'gro ba'i re bskong shog /sems tsam bskyed kyang brtson pas ma bsgrubs 'bras bu stobs 'phel ma gyur pas// lus sems sbyangs pa'i tshul las legs thob tshul khrims mi nyams yongs rdzogs shog /dang po'i sems ldan skyed byed lhag pa'i stobs ldan phra rags dge dang dge gzhan dag mi mthun bar chad dag gis g.yeng bar mi nus bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa yongs thob shog

/yang dag don la sbyor dang 'gal ba'i phyogs 'dzin brtson pa lhur blangs pa// chog par mi 'dzin byed pa'i go bgos bdud kyi rgyu 'dul brtson pa myur 'gyur shog /gzugs mthong 'og tu bsam pa brtan byed lhag pa mthong ba thob byed pa// zab don chags bral zhi ba don dam snying po myur thob shog /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs byed pa// chos kyi rang bzhin ma 'dres so sor rtog pa'i go 'phang mchog la sbyor bar shog /stobs bcu'i rgyu 'byung thabs dang smon lam stobs ldan ye shes pha rol phyin pa yongs rdzogs pas/ tshogs sbyor mthong spang sgom slob mthar phyin lam lnga yongs thob shog /rgyu 'bras gzhi lam bskrun pa'i mthu las rab dga' dri med 'od ldan dang*// bzhi pa 'od 'phro sbyang dka' dag dang mngon gyur ring 'gro ba// brgyad pa mi g.yo blo gros chos kyi sprin can kun tu 'od dang ma chags rdo rje 'dzin pa sa lam legs thob shog /'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu rang gzhan gnyis kyi don thob cing*/ 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa'i sems can rnams la smin gyur cig /bsam pa'i stobs dang smon lam bye ba'i stobs dag dang*// rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs bzhi dag gis bsgrubs pa yis// 'bras bu sku bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod zung 'jug rdzogs pa'i sku// nam mkha'i mthas khyab sems can rnams kyis myur thob shog /gang yang dus gsum bsags dang rang bzhin yod pa'i dge ba des bdag sogs sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog// ye dharma he tu pra bha wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wadata te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ ba dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā// dge'o// //
